analysis.reason: 일봉 RSI 42.7로 과매도 구간 진입 후 반등 시도 중. MACD 히스토그램 개선세 확인. 그러나 ADX 28.2로 추세 강도는 유지되나 -DI 34.0이 +DI 23.8보다 우위인 약세 흐름 지속. 5일 연속 음봉 마감 후 반등 시도하나 20일 이평선(1,589,650원) 하회 중. 52주 위치 42.9%로 하방 경직성 확인되나, 20일 이평선 저항 및 -DI 우위 지속으로 매수 전환은 이르다.
analysis.reasonEn: Daily RSI at 42.7 attempting to rebound from oversold territory. MACD histogram shows improvement. However, ADX at 28.2 indicates trend strength persists, but -DI at 34.0 remains above +DI at 23.8, continuing a weak trend. After 5 consecutive daily closes in the red, a rebound is attempted, but price remains below the 20-day MA (1,589,650 KRW). 52-week position at 42.9% confirms downside support, but resistance at the 20-day MA and persistent -DI dominance prevent a premature buy signal.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,500,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,580,800 KRW) / SMA20 (1,589,650 KRW) / SMA50 (2,027,000 KRW) — Below short-term and mid-term trends, confirming a downtrend in the mid-term.
· Position relative to SMA100 (1,751,353 KRW) / SMA200 (1,240,026 KRW) — Suggests potential shift to a weaker long-term trend.
· 52-week position (42.9%) — High relative to historical lows, confirming downside support.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.1 → 42.7) — Attempting to exit oversold territory, preparing to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-8051.5031 → 29227.4916) — Improvement confirmed, no signs of bearish reversal yet.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band 1,275,047 KRW) — Approaching the lower band, with a band width of 39.58% indicating potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (1,373,000 KRW) — Support expected around Pivot S1 (1,162,000 KRW) and SMA200 (1,240,026 KRW).
· Swing resistance (1,995,000 KRW) — Potential trend reversal if broken, currently facing resistance at the SMA20 (1,589,650 KRW).
· 5-day / 20-day price range pattern (5-day low 1.44M vs 20-day low 1.246M) — No Higher Low confirmed, potential for sideways movement.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.02x) — Moderate confidence in the current movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) — RSI attempting to exit oversold and MACD showing improvement, but resistance at the 20-day MA and persistent -DI dominance suggest it's too early for a buy signal. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
